name: io.github.comet-ml/opik-mcp
title: Opik
description: Read and score Opik traces, experiments, datasets and prompts from your AI assistant.

environmentVariables.name: OPIK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Opik API key, for Opik Cloud and self-hosted Comet. Leave unset for open-source Opik.

environmentVariables.name: OPIK_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Workspace name: the segment after comet.com/ in your Opik URL. Leave unset for open-source Opik.

environmentVariables.name: OPIK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Opik REST API base, for open-source Opik.

environmentVariables.name: COMET_URL_OVERRIDE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a self-hosted Comet platform; Opik's API is <url>/opik/api.
